      (no resolve_profile_flags at launch → golden #5 resolver invariant); jinja
      embed/rerank mode now reads the model tune, not profile flags.
    - MTP draft bundle re-injected model-driven (effective_mtp) into the model tune
      instead of the severed profile-flag path (was inside _profile_image_and_flags).
    - §21.7 managed-arg denylist PRESERVED: model_extra_args stays screened; the
      container.py shlex.quote-per-token JSON quoting fix (SLOT-B) is untouched.

    DO NOT RUN): folds each slot's effective tune into its model's defaults,
    provenance = source profile. Managed flags (-ngl/-c) split into the typed
    defaults.n_gpu_layers/context_size (never extra_args, or the denylist rejects
    them). Divergent-share REFUSAL: multiple slots → one model with divergent tunes
    refuses + reports, never silently picks. Idempotent + dry-run default;
    apply requires deploy_window=True. Pure planner is filesystem-free/unit-tested.

    fix(slots): per-slot image status reads root's store with tag precision
    
    A container slot runs its image out of ROOT's podman store, but hal0-api
    runs as the unprivileged hal0 user, whose own (rootless) image inspect
    hits a DIFFERENT store — so a READY slot on ghcr.io/.../hal0-rocmfpx:c077206
    showed IMAGE STATUS "missing". The O12 introspection seam also emitted
    tagless {{.Repository}}, so even a store-correct listing couldn't match a
    slot's tagged ref.
    
    - hal0-podman-ro: emit {{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} (same single read-only verb).
    - podman_introspect.images(): parse repo:tag, drop <none> dangling entries;
      result set now holds fully-qualified refs.
    - hardware._backend_state: intentionally repo-level, so strip the tag off each
      ref before matching — bare-repo behaviour preserved.
    - slots.pull_slot_image_status (+ the stream no-job branch): match the slot's
      full tagged ref against the ROOTFUL listing; fall back to the rootless
      inspect probe only when the seam yields no authoritative (rootful) listing,
      preserving pre-change behaviour on dev boxes.
    
    Note: the slot-list image_status in slot_view/__init__.py has the same latent
    rootless-store issue but is outside this lane's fence — flagged, not touched.

    * docs(images): design spec for container image system overhaul
    
    Unify slot image resolution through a single manifest-driven resolver, make hal0-rocmfpx the HW-gated platform default, and reconcile existing slots on hal0 update. Ref: fresh-install used stale amd-strix-halo-toolboxes:vulkan-radv-server.
    
    * docs(images): narrow scope — migration engine already wired, 4 surgical gaps
    
    retag_stale_slot_images() already runs on hal0 update; DEFAULT_ROCMFPX_IMAGE already canonical. Remaining: repoint basic seed profiles, extend STALE_ROCMFPX_IMAGE_REFS, HW-gate the default, rolling-tag+digest pin.
    
    * feat(images): HW-gated default image resolver (gfx1151 → rocmfpx)
    
    Add rocmfpx_capable(hw) + resolve_default_image(backend, device_class): Strix-Halo/gfx1151 GPU lanes get the unified hal0-rocmfpx runner, non-Strix AMD/CPU/CUDA fall back to the lean toolbox. Conservative — missing probe never forces the wrong-ISA runner. Foundation for repointing seed profiles + HW-gating retag_stale_slot_images. 11 tests.
    
    * docs(images): toolbox repo consolidation plan (Gap 0) + detach-fork recommendation
    
    Make Hal0ai/amd-strix-halo-toolboxes the single toolbox factory: add rocmfpx flavor (from Hal0_ROCmFPX fork), fold in NPU/TTS toolboxes, repoint CI to ghcr, wire hal0 manifest. Recommend detaching from kyuz0 fork while keeping it as an upstream git remote.
    
    * docs(images): resolve rocmfpx build-home + ROCmFPX upstream topology
    
    charlie12345/ROCmFPX already CI-builds+publishes the strix-rocmfp4 server image; Hal0_ROCmFPX inherited that docker.yml. Plan: enable+repoint it to publish into the unified package; keep Hal0_ROCmFPX a fork of charlie12345 (+ ciru-ai secondary remote) since hal0 integrates active upstream FPX work rather than maintaining it.
    
    * feat(images): HW-gated rocmfpx default for basic seed profiles + update retag
    
    - Basic seed profiles (vulkan/rocm/embed/rerank/vulkan-embed/vulkan-rerank/cpu-llm) blank their image -> defer to resolve_default_image; ProfileConfig allows empty image (=defer, whitespace still rejected).

    - retag_stale_slot_images: HW-gate the target (per slot backend/device_class) + no-op guard; add the old amd-strix-halo-toolboxes vulkan-radv-server / rocm-7.2.4-rocmfp4-server refs to STALE_ROCMFPX_IMAGE_REFS so hal0 update migrates existing Strix slots to rocmfpx (no-op on non-Strix).
    - Verified on Strix: vulkan/rocm/embed/rerank seed profiles now resolve to hal0-rocmfpx:c077206 (was vulkan-radv-server); cpu-llm stays on the lean toolbox. 139 affected tests pass.
    
    * refactor(images): rocmfpx is the universal AMD-GPU default (drop HW gate)
    
    The rocmfpx image ships mesa-vulkan-drivers + a compiled Vulkan/RADV backend (the live Strix slots already use it via -dev Vulkan0), so it runs on any AMD GPU, not just gfx1151 — the CMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES=gfx1151 pin only constrains the HIP kernels. Make it the default for all AMD GPU lanes; CUDA -> cuda image, CPU-only -> lean vulkan toolbox (7.5GB ROCm image is wasteful for CPU). Removes rocmfpx_capable/STRIX_HALO_HW_MARKERS/hardware probe from the resolver: deterministic, probe-free (no hardware.json read on the hot render path), and no test host-dependence. resolve_default_image + retag + _resolve_image_ref unchanged at call sites.
    
    * docs(images): sync design docs to the universal default (HW-gate dropped)
    
    Update the locked decisions, resolver section, rollout risks, addendum gap list, and phasing to reflect the shipped universal rocmfpx default (no gfx1151 HW gate) + mark the consumer-side gaps done in PR #1297. Historical HW-gate mentions kept but labelled superseded.
    
    * style(images): ruff format test_image_retag
    
    * fix(images): seed profiles pin rocmfpx directly (portable-profile safe)
    
    CI caught 3 failures from the earlier blank-image + validator-relax approach: the portable-profile system (parse_envelope/export/route) requires a concrete non-empty image. Since rocmfpx is now the universal GPU default, pin it directly in the basic GPU seed profiles (like the FPX profiles already do) instead of blanking; cpu-llm keeps the lean toolbox. Reverts the ProfileConfig validator relaxation (non-empty again). Referencing DEFAULT_ROCMFPX_IMAGE keeps a single-point bump.

-# Seed profile catalog — shipped with hal0, returned by `load_profiles_config()`
-# when /etc/hal0/profiles.toml is absent so GET /api/profiles is always
-# populated on a fresh install.
+# hal0 1.0 seeded profile catalog.
 #
-# Externalized from hal0.config.schema.SEED_PROFILES (P3-schema, spec Part A).
-# Loaded + validated by hal0.config.seeds.seed_profiles(); schema.py keeps a
-# bottom-of-module import shim (`SEED_PROFILES = _seeds.seed_profiles()`) so
-# every existing `from hal0.config.schema import SEED_PROFILES` call site is
-# unaffected.
+# Seeds are small, device-agnostic workload templates. Physical placement,
+# GPU offload, CPU threads, runner binary, and image pins belong to slots.
+# Model-family quirks belong in family_defaults.toml and per-model defaults.
+# Backend-specific experiments are clone-only examples, not catalog seeds.
 #
-# Image-pin sentinels: any `image` value starting with "@" is a placeholder
-# resolved by hal0.config.seeds against the still-in-schema.py image
-# constants (DEFAULT_ROCMFPX_IMAGE / FALLBACK_VULKAN_IMAGE /
-# FALLBACK_CUDA_IMAGE) — see the ML-runner handshake (spec §H). Do NOT
-# hardcode a resolved digest here for the ROCmFPX/Vulkan-fallback lanes; that
-# would fork the pin the ML-runner registry is about to own. Non-rocmfpx
-# images (flm, kokoro, qwen3tts, the upstream llama.cpp CUDA image, the
-# comfyui digest) are literal — they are not part of the ROCmFPX pin.
-#
-# Slugs are backend-agnostic workload names — the `backend` field (not the
-# slug) carries the ROCm/Vulkan choice, and the card chip renders the backend
-# as colour, so the slug no longer repeats it. GPU profiles set `backend`;
-# non-GPU profiles (npu/cpu/img) omit it and let `device_class` drive display.
-#
